column1: # Checker soundness fixtures: twenty-two pairs covering the TWENTY-ONE confirmed
# wrong-verdict defects in published VeriPB 3.0.2 (defect 7 has two
# manifestations with opposite wrong verdicts, hence 22 rows for 21 defects).
# Every one of these is a formula/proof pair where the checker's verdict
# CONTRADICTS the truth. A checker AY is willing to trust must refuse all
# The gate asserts REJECT = "printed no accepting `s ...` verdict line at any
# guarantee level". `s VERIFIED NO CONCLUSION` is also a rejection here (the
# proof concluded nothing), and so is a parse/checking error with no `s` line.
# These run in ~0.1s total, so they gate every push. See README.md for what
# each bug is and where it was fixed.
# Rows 10 to 22 cover defects 9 to 21, the post-fork ones. They were fixed here
# as ay patch 0002 and later reconciled into the fork, so the single pinned patch
# (the fork's alab-main delta) now closes them; stock upstream fixes none of
# them. Each of those directories also carries `sat.pbp` — the
# SAME formula and the SAME binary, proved SATISFIABLE — and `variants/`,
# including a one-knob control that is rejected by the unfixed checker too and so
# pins the forgery to the defect rather than to "large numbers" or "that rule is
# broken", plus a positive variant that must keep being ACCEPTED so an
# over-broad "fix" cannot pass. Those are not rows: the schema is one pair per
# row and the headline pair is the one that reaches the defect from an ordinary
